incomePathways.rationale: Otherwise-paid personal-assistance consumption and net work resources jointly logged with full participant time/access costs. Supplies retail value and ordinary future earnings of survivors are not counted.
incomePathways.counterfactual: Public/free naloxone, other harm-reduction providers and household spending or assistance without HRAC; resource displacement fraction and incidence are hypotheses.
